title: More Fixes
description: I'll fix bugs that don't bother me but still bother me.
body:
This mod resolves issue other minor bugs.

Additionally, several bugs that caused structures to generate incorrectly have been fixed.
- Incorrect generation of well bottoms in plains villages ([MC-194518](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-194518))
- Fixed minor issues with outpost construction methods
- Fixed pyramids that were not perfectly symmetrical.
- Various other fixes
- Fix [MC-260949](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-260949) (Only 1.21.1)
